question-poser.name: question-poser
question-poser.description: Turns the selected literature gap into one sharp research question. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 0 step 0d, after gap-scout. Produces a single important, open, non-obvious question — not a framework, not an approach (that is Stage 1's job).

question-referee.name: question-referee
question-referee.description: Vets the posed research question on importance, openness, and non-obviousness. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 0 step 0e, replacing the self-graded Gate 0. Search-grounded; returns a 0-100 viability score and a verdict.

idea-generator.name: idea-generator
idea-generator.description: Brainstorms candidate mechanisms and model ideas for a given problem. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 1 of the pipeline. Produces developed sketches — not full theories, but enough to evaluate.

idea-reviewer.name: idea-reviewer
idea-reviewer.description: Evaluates and ranks candidate idea sketches. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 1 to iterate with the idea-generator. Decides when an idea is ready for full theory development.

referee.name: referee
referee.description: Simulated top-journal referee. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 6 of the pipeline. Always runs fresh with no knowledge of previous reports or changes.
referee.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch

scorer.name: scorer
scorer.description: Adversarial theory scorer. The orchestrator launches this agent at Gate 4. Aggregates all evaluation outputs and makes the advance/revise/abandon decision.

self-attacker.name: self-attacker
self-attacker.description: Adversarial weakness finder. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 4 after novelty check passes. Finds every possible weakness before the referee does.
